Everwise – New Affiliate Partnership Overview

About Our Brand:
Everwise creates practical, easy-to-read self-help eBooks designed to help people make real improvements in their daily lives. Our guides cover topics like parenting, faith, mental health, fitness, and first-time home buying — written with warmth, honesty, and actionable advice.

What Makes Us Different:
We focus on real-life guidance that readers can actually use. Each eBook is affordable, relatable, and instantly downloadable, making it easy for anyone to start improving their life right away.

Affiliate Earnings:
Earn 30% commission on every sale through your unique link. Payouts are made via PayPal every 1st of the month, and earnings are uncapped — the more you promote, the more you earn.

Promotion Style:
We give our affiliates full creative freedom — no posting requirements or restrictions. Share our guides however fits best with your audience. Affiliates also receive a free copy of the eBooks they promote (just send us an email for the preferred books).

Contact & Info:
🌐 www.Everwise.store
📧 EverwiseStore@outlook.com
